functions.ghostTokenValid: function ghostTokenValid(value){ return typeof value==='string' && value.length===GH_TOKEN_HEX && /^[0-9a-f]+$/.test(value); }
functions.ghostRelayHeaders: function ghostRelayHeaders(token,json){ const headers={'X-Ghost-Token':token}; if(json) headers['Content-Type']='application/json'; return headers; }
functions.ghostSerializedBytes: function ghostSerializedBytes(value){ try{ return ghostUtf8Bytes(JSON.stringify(value)); }catch(e){ return GH_MAX_BYTES+1; } }
